mapper.select: SELECT wsr.uid , wsr.account_id , wsr.user_name , wsr.phone_num , wsr.email_address , wsr.role FROM worker_sms_receiver wsr JOIN worker_sms_concern_page_receiver wscpr ON wsr.account_id = wscpr.receiver_id JOIN worker_sms_concern_page wscp ON wscpr.concern_page_code = wscp.code WHERE wscpr.concern_page_code = #{concernPageCode} AND wscpr.on_service = '1' AND wscp.on_service = '1' AND wsr.on_service = '1'
